sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_1d4be174106ec7104699cdb60f0cc927
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>executequoteline</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTRequest*/ request, /*RESTResponse*/ response) {
    var body = request.body.data;
    var quoteSysId = body.quoteSysId;
    var selectedRecordIds = body.selectedRecordIds; // array of sys_ids from the client

    try {
        var quoteGr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
        if (quoteGr.get(quoteSysId)) {
           
            var subflowInputs = {};
            subflowInputs['quote'] = quoteGr;
           
            // 1. Create a GlideRecord collection for the selected items
            var stagingGr = new GlideRecord('x_fitsg_fits_som_1_som_sap_vertraege_getlbbworderdata');
            // 2. Find all records matching the array of sys_ids
            stagingGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', selectedRecordIds.join(','));
            stagingGr.query();
           
            // 3. Pass the queried collection directly to the 'List of Records' input
            subflowInputs['selected_staging_records'] = stagingGr;

            sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
                .subflow('x_fitsg_fits_som_1.save_sap_order_data_as_quote_line')
                .inBackground()
                .withInputs(subflowInputs)
                .run();
               
            return { success: true };
        }
        return { success: false, error: "Quote record not found" };
    } catch (ex) {
        return { success: false, error: ex.message };
    }
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/sn_quote_mgmt/executequoteline/execute</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/execute</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-04 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Quote Details Tabs">bd8c7ca2d0594b501f18ceb26814d7c0</child><cloned>2026-06-08 15:20:02</cloned><last_validated>2026-06-08 15:20:02</last_validated><parent display_value="Order Details Tabs">b1023c87777261105c24f664be5a99fd</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function(spUtil, $scope, $timeout, $window) {
	function isRefreshNeededForChanges(changes) {
		var isNeeded = changes.length > 0 && !(
			changes.length == 1 && (
				changes[0] == 'comments' || changes[0] == 'work_notes' || changes[0] == 'task_percent_complete'
			)
		);
		return isNeeded;
	}
	var c = this;
	
	c.KEYS = {
		LEFT: 37,
		RIGHT: 39
	};
	
	//Click First visible Tab
	function clickFirstVisibleTab() {
		var uibTabs = $('#std-uib-tabset').children('ul');
		var firstVisibleTab = uibTabs.children('.uib-vis-tab:first').find('>a');
			$timeout(function(){
				firstVisibleTab[0].click();
			});
	}
	//Click dropdown menuitem on pressing right from tabs
	c.keyUpOnTabs = function(e) {
		var uibTabs = $('#std-uib-tabset').children('ul');
		if(e.keyCode == c.KEYS.RIGHT && uibTabs && uibTabs.children('.uib-vis-tab:not(.hide-item):last')[0] == e.currentTarget) {
			var selectables = $('#dropDownMenu').find('.hide-item:last').next();
			if (selectables && selectables.length != 0) {
				$timeout(function(){
					selectables[0].click();
				});
			}
			else
				clickFirstVisibleTab();
		}
	}
	
	c.keyUpOnDropDown = function(e) {
		var selectedMenuItem = $('#dropDownMenu').find('.tick-mark').parent();
		if(e.keyCode == c.KEYS.RIGHT) {
			var rightChild = getNextOrPrevChild(selectedMenuItem.next(), true); // Get next child of selected menu item
			if (rightChild) {
				$timeout(function(){
					rightChild[0].click();
				});
			}
			else
				clickFirstVisibleTab(); // Move focus to first visible tab when no more menu Items present in dropdown
		}
		else if(e.keyCode == c.KEYS.LEFT) {
			var leftChild =	getNextOrPrevChild(selectedMenuItem.prev(), false); // Get previous child of selected menu item
			if (leftChild) {
				$timeout(function(){
					leftChild[0].click()
				});
			}
		}
	}
	
	function getNextOrPrevChild(child, right) {
		if (right && child && child.next().length != 0 && child[0].tagName != 'LI') // To handle if next child is tooltip
			return child.next();
		else if (!right && child && child.prev().length != 0 && child[0].tagName != 'LI') // To handle if prev child is tooltip
			return child.prev();
		else if (child && child.length != 0)
			return child;
	}
	
	c.data.tabsCopy = Array.from(c.data.tabs);
	var primaryWidth = 0;
	$scope.selectedTab = null;

	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, $scope.data.table, "sys_id=" + $scope.data.sys_id, function(name) {
		if (isRefreshNeededForChanges(name.data.changes))
			$scope.server.update();
	});

var doAdapt = function(isSelectedTabPrimary) {
	if (!c.data.canRead && c.data.tabsCopy.length == 0)
		return;
	
	var selectedTab = $scope.selectedTab;
	var primaryItems = document.getElementsByClassName("uib-vis-tab");
	var moreItems = document.getElementsByClassName("uib-more-tab");

  // reveal all items for the calculation
  Object.keys(primaryItems).forEach(function(item) {
    primaryItems[item].classList.remove('hide-item');
  });
	
  // hide items that won't fit in the Primary
  var stopWidth = 0;
	
	if (document.getElementById("std-uib-tabset")) {
		primaryWidth = document.getElementById("std-uib-tabset").offsetWidth;
	}
	var includeInMenuItem;
	var actualPossibleWidth = primaryWidth;
  Object.keys(primaryItems).forEach(function(item, i) {
    primaryItems[item].id = 'uib-st-tab-' + c.data.tabsCopy[i].order;
    moreItems[item].id = 'uib-more-tab-' + c.data.tabsCopy[i].order;
    moreItems[item].children[0].setAttribute('role', "option");
    if (primaryWidth >= stopWidth + primaryItems[item].offsetWidth && !includeInMenuItem) {
			stopWidth += primaryItems[item].offsetWidth;
			moreItems[item].classList.add('hide-item');
			primaryItems[item].classList.remove('hide-item');
    } else if(primaryItems[item] == primaryItems[primaryItems.length - 1]) {
			document.getElementById("more-btn-text").style.maxWidth = (primaryItems[item - 1].offsetWidth + actualPossibleWidth) - stopWidth - 50 + 'px';
			includeInMenuItem = true;
			showItemInMenu(item - 1);
			showItemInMenu(item);
		} else if (actualPossibleWidth - stopWidth < parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(document.getElementById("more-btn"), null).getPropertyValue('min-width'))) {
			showItemInMenu(item - 1);
		} else {
			var moreBtnWidth = 124;
			document.getElementById("more-btn-text").style.maxWidth = actualPossibleWidth - stopWidth - moreBtnWidth - 50 + 'px';
			includeInMenuItem = true;
			showItemInMenu(item);
			}
  });
	
	function showItemInMenu(index) {
		primaryItems[index].classList.add('hide-item');
		moreItems[index].classList.remove('hide-item');
	}
	// show the selected tab and remove from more after clicked
	if (selectedTab && document.getElementById('uib-st-tab-' + selectedTab.order)) {
		var tabItem = document.getElementById('uib-st-tab-' + selectedTab.order);
		var menuItem = document.getElementById('uib-more-tab-' + selectedTab.order);
	
		if (!menuItem.className.includes("hide-item")) { //If menu item is present in the dropdown and is the selectedTab
			menuItem.children[0].classList.add("tick-mark");
			menuItem.parentElement.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', menuItem.id);
			menuItem.children[0].setAttribute('aria-selected', true);
			addSelected(menuItem); //Added for accessibilty
		}
		setTimeout(function(){
			if (!isSelectedTabPrimary) 
				tabItem.children[0].click();
		 }, 0);
	}
	$scope.showOrHideMoreButton(moreItems);	
}

// adapt on load
$timeout(function(){ 
	doAdapt();
	c.more_title = "${More_menu}";
}, 0);

$window.addEventListener('load',function() {
    // handle load event
	doAdapt();
	c.more_title = "${More_menu}";
});

var prevTab;
function renameMoreTab(tabSelected) {
	var moreBtn = document.getElementById("more-btn");
	var selectedItem;
	if (tabSelected)
		selectedItem = document.getElementById('uib-more-tab-'+ tabSelected.order);
	var menuItemHidden;
	if (tabSelected && selectedItem)
		menuItemHidden = selectedItem.className.includes("hide-item");
	if (moreBtn && tabSelected && !menuItemHidden) {
		moreBtn.removeAttribute('tabindex'); //As menuitem is selected, now dropdown should appear in tabbing sequence
		c.more_title = tabSelected.name;
		if (!moreBtn.className.includes('active-dropdown'))
			moreBtn.className += ' active-dropdown';
	}
	else if (moreBtn && tabSelected && menuItemHidden) {
		c.more_title = "${More_menu}";
		 $("#more-btn").removeClass("active-dropdown");
		moreBtn.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); //Reset tabindex -1
	}
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
	$timeout(function(){
		doAdapt();
	});
	renameMoreTab($scope.selectedTab);
	if (prevTab && prevTab.childNodes[1])
			prevTab.removeChild(prevTab.childNodes[1]);
}) // adapt on window resize

function doOperationOnPrevTab(prevTab) {
	if (prevTab) { //Remove the above added attr from previous selected tab on change of selection
		prevTab.setAttribute('aria-selected', false);
		prevTab.classList.remove("tick-mark");
		if (prevTab.childNodes[1])
			prevTab.removeChild(prevTab.childNodes[1]);
	}
}

function addSelected(menuItem) {// Add span for reading the selected menu item in dropdown
    var textSpan = document.createElement("span");
    textSpan.innerHTML = "${ Selected}";
    textSpan.classList.add("sr-only");
    menuItem.children[0].appendChild(textSpan);
}

$scope.tabSelectedInMore = function(tab) {
	doOperationOnPrevTab(prevTab);
	prevTab = document.getElementById('uib-more-tab-'+ tab.order).children[0];
	$scope.selectedTab = tab;
	renameMoreTab($scope.selectedTab);
	doAdapt();
	var moreBtn = document.getElementById("more-btn");
	moreBtn.removeAttribute('tabindex'); //As menuitem is selected, now dropdown should appear in tabbing sequence
	if (moreBtn)
		moreBtn.focus();
}

$scope.onTabClick = function(tab) {
	renameMoreTab(tab);
	doOperationOnPrevTab(prevTab);
	var selectedItem = document.getElementById('uib-more-tab-'+ tab.order);
	if (selectedItem)
		prevTab = selectedItem.children[0];
	$scope.selectedTab = tab;
	doAdapt(true);
		$scope.$emit('sp.components.resize');
	};
	
$scope.showOrHideMoreButton = function(moreItems) {
	c.showMore = false;
	//hide dropdown if no elements are present
	Object.keys(moreItems).forEach(function(item) {
		if (!moreItems[item].className.includes("hide-item"))
				c.showMore = true;
	});
	}
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>#std-uib-tabset {&#13;

}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>order_details_tabs_telco</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>Order Details Tabs</name><option_schema>[{"name":"rich_text_editor","section":"other","label":"Enable Rich Text Editor","type":"boolean","default_value": "false"}, {"name":"at_mentions","section":"other","label":"Enable @ Mentions (works only when Rich Text Editor is enabled)","type":"boolean","default_value": "false"}]</option_schema><public>false</public><roles>snc_external,snc_internal</roles><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    var tableName = $sp.getParameter('table');
    var sysId = $sp.getParameter('sys_id');
    var record = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(tableName, sysId);

    data.canRead = (record != null && record.isValid() && record.canRead());
    if (!data.canRead)
        return;

    if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == 'true')
        data.headless = true;
    else if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == 'false')
        data.headless = false;
    else if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == null)
        data.headless = false;
    else
        return;
    data.table = record.getTableName();
    data.sys_id = record.getUniqueValue();

    var tabs = [];
    var test = data.table;
    var config = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getConfig(data.table, record.sys_domain);
    var pluginManager = new GlidePluginManager();

    //Showing a order confirmation message on cart checkout
	var cartOrderNumber = gs.getSession().getClientData('current_order_number');
    if (!gs.nil(cartOrderNumber)) {
        gs.addInfoMessage(gs.getMessage("Your order has been placed successfully. Order ID: #{0}.", cartOrderNumber));
        gs.getSession().putClientData('current_order_number', '');
    }

    var portalGr = $sp.getPortalRecord();
    var orderLinesView = portalGr.getValue('url_suffix');
    var tab_1 = {
        name: gs.getMessage('Order lines'),
        order: 1,
        widget: $sp.getWidget('order_line_embed_telco', {
            sys_id: data.sys_id,
            table: 'sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_line_item',
            view: (orderLinesView == 'business_portal') ? 'business_portal' : (orderLinesView == 'blsp') ? 'blsp' : (orderLinesView == 'partner') ? 'partner_portal' : 'csm'
        })
    };
    tabs.push(tab_1);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt.SAPOrderUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>SAPOrderUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var SAPOrderUtil = Class.create();
SAPOrderUtil.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    triggerSAPSubflow: function() {
        var quoteSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_quote_sys_id');
       
        try {
            var quoteGr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
            if (quoteGr.get(quoteSysId)) {
                var subflowInputs = {};
                subflowInputs['quote'] = quoteGr;
                subflowInputs['contract_number'] = '7000*';

                sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
                    .subflow('x_fitsg_fits_som_1.retrieve_sap_order_data')
                    .inBackground()
                    .withInputs(subflowInputs)
                    .run();

                return "SUCCESS";
            }
            return "RECORD_NOT_FOUND";
        } catch (ex) {
            return "ERROR: " + ex.message;
        }
    },

    type: 'SAPOrderUtil'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-26 11:59:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>cdb95b3190d68f501f183742f58c9a63</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SAPOrderUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_cdb95b3190d68f501f183742f58c9a63</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-26 11:59:18</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf9fe0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_cdb95b3190d68f501f183742f58c9a63</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>c15771a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc0848d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:28</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_data_broker_transform"><sys_ux_data_broker_transform action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><acl_failure_result/><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt.SOM Retrieve SAP Orders</api_name><batch_exclude>false</batch_exclude><description/><mutates_server_data>false</mutates_server_data><name>SOM Retrieve SAP Orders</name><output_schema/><private>false</private><props>[
  {
    "name": "quoteSysId",
    "label": "Quote Sys ID",
    "description": "Sys ID of the quote record",
    "type": "string",
    "mandatory": true,
    "readOnly": false
  }
]
</props><required_translations/><schema_version>1.0.0</schema_version><script><![CDATA[(function transform(inputs, outputs) {
    gs.info("=== DATA BROKER CALLED with quoteSysId: " + inputs.quoteSysId);

    try {
        if (!inputs.quoteSysId) {
            gs.error("=== DATA BROKER ERROR: quoteSysId input was empty!");
            return { success: false, error: "Missing quoteSysId" };
        }

        var quoteGr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
        if (quoteGr.get(inputs.quoteSysId)) {
           
            var subflowInputs = {};
            subflowInputs['quote'] = quoteGr; // Passing GlideRecord instance
            subflowInputs['contract_number'] = '7000*';

            sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
                .subflow('x_fitsg_fits_som_1.retrieve_sap_order_data')
                .inBackground()
                .withInputs(subflowInputs)
                .run();

            gs.info("=== DATA BROKER SUCCESS: Subflow Queued for " + quoteGr.getDisplayValue());
            return { success: true };
        } else {
            gs.error("=== DATA BROKER ERROR: Record not found for sys_id " + inputs.quoteSysId);
            return { success: false, error: "Record not found" };
        }
    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error("=== DATA BROKER EXCEPTION: " + ex.message);
        return { success: false, error: ex.message };
    }
})(inputs, outputs);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-25 13:22:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>f1e22e25905a4f501f183742f58c9a86</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOM Retrieve SAP Orders</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform_f1e22e25905a4f501f183742f58c9a86</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-26 11:34:11</sys_updated_on></sys_ux_data_broker_transform><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcef910000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform_f1e22e25905a4f501f183742f58c9a86</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>185731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08409</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default">c862502443b9b1105bc56b23cbb8f27b</macroponent><name>debugTriggerSubflow</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({ api, helpers }) {
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId || api.context.page.sysId || api.state.sysId;
    console.log("=== STEP 1: GOT SYS_ID ===", sysId);

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id! ===");
        return;
    }

    // 1. Show immediate feedback
    api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
        items: [{
            id: 'sap_start_' + Date.now(),
            status: 'info',
            icon: 'info-circle-outline',
            content: 'SAP Synchronisation gestartet. Bitte warten...',
            action: { type: 'dismiss' }
        }]
    });

    // 2. Execute the REST API via snHttp
    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/trigger_sap_subflow/execute";
    console.log("=== STEP 2: EXECUTING VIA HELPERS.SNHTTP ===", endpoint);

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quoteSysId: sysId }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        console.log("=== STEP 3: SUBFLOW DISPATCH SUCCESS ===", response);
        
        var isSuccess = true;
        var errorMsg = "Unbekannter Fehler bei der SAP-Synchronisation";

        // Safely parse the response
        if (response && response.data && response.data.result) {
            if (response.data.result.success === false) {
                isSuccess = false;
                errorMsg = response.data.result.error || errorMsg;
            }
        } else if (response && response.response && response.response.result) {
            if (response.response.result.success === false) {
                isSuccess = false;
                errorMsg = response.response.result.error || errorMsg;
            }
        }

        // Emit final status
        if (!isSuccess) {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                items: [{ id: 'sap_err_' + Date.now(), status: 'critical', content: errorMsg, action: { type: 'dismiss' } }]
            });
        } else {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                items: [{ id: 'sap_suc_' + Date.now(), status: 'positive', content: 'SAP synchronisiert', action: { type: 'dismiss' } }]
            });
        }
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{ id: 'sap_http_err_' + Date.now(), status: 'critical', content: 'Server error.', action: { type: 'dismiss' } }]
        });
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-26 09:07:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>509139e990964f501f183742f58c9a36</sys_id><sys_mod_count>20</sys_mod_count><sys_name>debugTriggerSubflow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_509139e990964f501f183742f58c9a36</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-07 14:59:07</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf5450000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_509139e990964f501f183742f58c9a36</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>b85731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

                                                    "payload": {
                                                        "script": {
                                                            "apiVersion": "1.0.0",
                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n    api,\n    event\n}) {\n    return {\n        propName: \"selectedTabIndex\",\n        value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n    };\n\n    function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n        if (showRequestTracker()) {\n            var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n            for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n                if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n            }\n        }\n        return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n    }\n\n    function showRequestTracker() {\n        var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n        if (extraParams != null) {\n            var params = extraParams.split(',');\n            return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n                'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n}",
                                                            "scriptSysId": null,

                                                "apiVersion": "2.0.0",
                                                "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers\n */\nfunction evaluateProperty({\n    api,\n    helpers\n}) {\n    const productRecommendationDetails = api.data.quote_management.productRecommendationDetails;\n    if (!productRecommendationDetails) return true;\n    \n    const hasWriterRole = api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"admin\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"maint\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"sn_quote_mgmt_core.quote_writer\") != -1;\n    const isSalesAgreementEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteForSalesAgreement;\n    const isQuoteInTerminalState = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteInTerminatedState;\n    const isPluginEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isProductRecommendationPluginEnabled;\n\n    return !(hasWriterRole && !isSalesAgreementEnabled && !isQuoteInTerminalState && isPluginEnabled);\n}",

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="DELETE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt.LBBWRevenueContractsAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Script include for client script in Quote Management - Revenue Contracts "Clear all" button.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LBBWRevenueContractsAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var LBBWRevenueContractsAjax = Class.create();
LBBWRevenueContractsAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    deleteAllContracts: function() {
        var quoteId = this.getParameter('sysparm_quote_id');
       
        if (!quoteId) {
            return 'error: no quote ID provided';
        }

        var contractGr = new GlideRecord('x_fitsg_fits_som_1_lbbw_revenue_contracts');
        contractGr.addQuery('quote', quoteId);
        contractGr.query();
       
        var count = contractGr.getRowCount();
        contractGr.deleteMultiple();
       
        return 'success: ' + count + ' records deleted';
    },

    type: 'LBBWRevenueContractsAjax'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-14 14:24:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>aa6fad40f4b24f501f18b238e2e23812</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LBBWRevenueContractsAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_aa6fad40f4b24f501f18b238e2e23812</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-14 14:26:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

	function isRefreshNeededForChanges(changes) {
		var isNeeded = changes.length > 0 && !(
			changes.length == 1 && (
				changes[0] == 'comments' || changes[0] == 'work_notes' || changes[0] == 'task_percent_complete'
			)
		);
		return isNeeded;
	}
	// Breadcrumbs
	var bc = [{label: $scope.data.internationalized_orders ? $scope.data.internationalized_orders : "${Orders}", url: '?view=portal&table=sn_ind_tmt_orm_order&id=customer_orders&target=customer_order_details'}, {label: $scope.data.number.display_value}];
	$rootScope.$broadcast('sp.update.breadcrumbs', bc);
	var c = this;
	if (c.data.is_new_order) {
		$timeout(function() {
			spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(c.data.requestSubmitMsg);
		}, 500);
		
	}
	c.showMore = c.showControls = false;
	fieldsCount = 0; // actual fields that will be rendered
	angular.forEach(c.data.fields, function(field) {
		if (field.type !== 'workflow' && (field.type !== 'decimal' || field.value != 0))
				fieldsCount++;
	});
	if (fieldsCount > 3)
		c.showMore = c.showControls = true;
	c.data.currentActionWidget = $scope.data.actionWidget;
	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, $scope.data.table, "sys_id=" + $scope.data.sys_id, function(name) {
		if (isRefreshNeededForChanges(name.data.changes)) {
			c.data.currentActionWidget = null;
			$scope.server.update().then(function(response) {
					c.data.currentActionWidget = response.actionWidget;
					if (c.data.isFocusRequired)
						c.data.currentActionWidget.isFocusRequired = c.data.isFocusRequired;
			});
		}
		else {
			c.server.get().then(function(response) {
						c.data.headerFields = response.data.headerFields;
					});
		}
	});
	$scope.$on('focusOnActions', function(evt, data) {
		 c.data.isFocusRequired = data.isFocusRequired;
		});
	
	$scope.hideMessage = function($scope) {
		c.hide = true;
	}
	$scope.openProfile = function(profileId) {
		$window.open('?id=user_profile&sys_id=' + profileId, '_blank');
	};
	$scope.description = $sce.trustAsHtml($scope.data.description);
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.panel-heading {&#13;

	var tableName = $sp.getParameter('table');
	
	var sysId = $sp.getParameter('sys_id');
	var record = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(tableName, sysId);
	data.isExternalUser = !gs.hasRole('snc_internal');
	data.is_new_order = (($sp.getParameter("is_new_order") + '') === "true");
	
	data.canRead = hasReadAcces(record);
	if (!data.canRead)
		return;
	
	if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == 'true')
		data.headless = true;
	else if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == 'false')
		data.headless = false;
	else if ($sp.getParameter('headless') == null)
		data.headless = false;
	else
		return;

	if (data.headless)
		data.hideHeader = true;

	tableName = record.getTableName();
	sysId = record.getUniqueValue();
	
	var sdField;
	var headerFields = [];
	var showDomainState = false;
	
	//URL has domain table
	if (tableName != 'universal_request') {
		//Check if universal_request field is present and it is a universal request
		if (record.isValidField('universal_request') && !record.universal_request.nil()) {
			data.urLink = '?id=standard_ticket&table=universal_request&sys_id=' + record.universal_request.sys_id;
			var ur = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord('universal_request', record.universal_request);
			if (!hasReadAcces(ur)) {
				readHeaderFields(record);
				showDomainState = true;
			}
			else {
				data.number = $sp.getField(ur, 'number');
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(ur, 'sys_created_on'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(record, 'sys_updated_on'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(ur, 'status'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(ur, 'number'));
				if($sp.getField(ur, 'short_description')) {
					sdField = $sp.getField(ur, 'short_description');
				} else {
					sdField = $sp.getField(ur, 'number');
				}
				
			}
			//URL-non primary ticket
			if (record.universal_request.primary_task != record.sys_id)
						data.primary_ticket_link = '?id=standard_ticket&table=universal_request&sys_id=' + record.universal_request;
		}
		//It is a domain ticket
		else {
			readHeaderFields(record);
			showDomainState = true;
		}
 }
  //URL-Table name is universal request
	else {
		//Domain ticket is created
		if (!record.primary_task.nil()) {
			data.urLink = '?id=standard_ticket&table=universal_request&sys_id=' + record.sys_id;
			var primary_table = record.primary_task.getRefRecord().getTableName();
			var primaryGR = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(primary_table, record.primary_task + '');
			data.canReadPrimary = hasReadAcces(primaryGR);
			if (!data.canReadPrimary) {
				readHeaderFields(record);
				record = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(primary_table, record.primary_task);
			}
			else { //can read primary ticket
				
				if($sp.getField(record, 'short_description')) {
					sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'short_description');
				} else {
					sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'number');
				}
				// sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'short_description');
				data.number = $sp.getField(record, 'number');
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(record, 'sys_created_on'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(primaryGR, 'sys_updated_on'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(record, 'status'));
				headerFields.push($sp.getField(record, 'number'));

				record = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(primary_table, record.primary_task);
				tableName = record.getTableName();
				sysId = record.getUniqueValue();
			}
		}
		//No domain ticket assigned
		else
			readHeaderFields(record);
	}
	
	if (sdField == null || !sdField.value) {//Use number if SD is not there
		data.isEmpty = true;
		sdField = data.number;
	}

	data.title = sdField ? sdField.display_value : record.getLabel();
	data.headerFields = headerFields;
	data.requestSubmitMsg = gs.getMessage("Thank You. Your request {0} has been submitted." , data.number ? data.number.display_value : "");
	
	data.canReadConfig = hasReadAcces(record);
	if (!data.canReadConfig)
		return;

	var config = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getConfig(tableName, record.sys_domain);

	if (config) {
		if (showDomainState && config.state_field != 'state') {
			var configState = $sp.getField(record, config.state_field);
			headerFields.forEach(function(field, index, that) {
				if (field.name == 'state') {
					that[index] = configState;
				}
			})
		}
		data.show_info_widget = config.show_info_widget;
		if (!data.show_info_widget)
			showConfigTicketFields (config, record);
		else
			showTicketWidget(config, tableName, sysId);

		data.table = tableName;
		data.sys_id = sysId;

		showActionWidget(config, tableName, sysId);
		if (record.isValidField('description') && record.description.canRead())
			showDescription(config, record);
	}
	
	function hasReadAcces(record) {
		return (record != null && record.isValid() && record.canRead());
	}
	
	function readHeaderFields(record) {
		if($sp.getField(record, 'short_description')) {
					sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'short_description');
		} else {
					sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'number');
		}
		// sdField = $sp.getField(record, 'short_description');
		data.number = $sp.getField(record, 'number');
		headerFields = $sp.getFields(record, 'sys_created_on, sys_updated_on, state');
	}
	
	function showConfigTicketFields(config, record) {
		var fieldNames = ['consumer', 'account', 'seller_organization', 'contact', 'order_date', 'state', 'order_category', 'total_discount', 'total_monthly_recurring_price_v2', 'total_one_time_price','total_amount_v2', 'partner', 'partner_contact', 'contract'];
		if (config.info_fields)
			fieldNames = config.info_fields.split(',');
		var fields = [];

			fieldNames.forEach(function (fName) {
				var fElement = record.getElement(fName);
				if (!fElement)
					return;

				if (!fElement.canRead())
					return;
				
			
				var type = fElement.getED().getInternalType();
				if (type == 'glide_list')
					loadGlideListFieldInfo(fElement, fName, type, record, fields);
				else if (type == 'workflow')
					loadWorkflowFieldInfo(fElement, fName, type, record, fields);
				else {
					var displayValue;
					var ed = fElement.getED();
					if(ed.getInternalType() == 'currency'){
						displayValue = fElement.getCurrencyDisplayValue();
					}else if((fName == 'recurring_price' && !record.recurring_frequency.nil()))
						displayValue = fElement.getDisplayValue() + " " + record.getDisplayValue('recurring_frequency');
					else
						displayValue = fElement.getDisplayValue();
					var f = {
						display_value: displayValue,
						label: fElement.getLabel(),
						name: fElement.getName(),
						type: type,
						value: (fName == 'sys_updated_on' && record.getValue("sys_mod_count") <= 0) ? '' : fElement.toString()
					};
					
					if (!f.value)
						return;

					if (type == 'reference') {
						var reference = fElement.getReferenceTable();
						f.reference = reference;
						var orderRecord = new GlideRecordSecure(reference);
						orderRecord.addQuery('sys_id', fElement);
						orderRecord.query();
						if (!orderRecord.next()){
							return;
						}
						if (reference == 'customer_contact' || reference == 'consumer' || reference == 'partner' || reference == 'partner_contact' || reference == 'account') {
							f.user = {
								userID: f.value,
								name: f.display_value,
								avatar: GlideAvatarFinder.getAvatarPath(f.value),
								initials: buildInitials(f.display_value)
							}
						}
					}
					fields.push(f);
				}
			});
			data.internationalized_orders = gs.getMessage("Orders");
			data.fields = fields;
	}
	
	function loadGlideListFieldInfo(fElement, fName, type, record, fields) {
		var val = fElement.toString();
		var f = {
			display_value: fElement.getDisplayValue() ? fElement.getDisplayValue().split(",") : '',
			label: fElement.getLabel(),
			type: type,
			value: val ? val.split(",") : '',
			reference: fElement.getED().getReference()
		};
		if (!f.value)
			return;

		var gReference = fElement.getED().getReference();
		if (gReference == '"customer_contact"' || gReference == 'consumer' || gReference == 'partner' || gReference == 'partner_contact' || gReference == 'account') {

			f.user = [];
			var person; 
			for(var u = 0; u < f.value.length; u++){
				f.user.push(person = {
					userID: f.value[u],
					name: f.display_value[u],
					avatar: GlideAvatarFinder.getAvatarPath(f.value[u]),
					initials: buildInitials(f.display_value[u])
				})
			}
		}
		fields.push(f);
	}
	
	function loadWorkflowFieldInfo(fElement, fName, type, record, fields) {
		var f = {
			display_value: fElement.getDisplayValue(),
			label: fElement.getLabel(),
			type: type,
			value: fElement.toString()
		};
		f.stageWidget = $sp.getWidget('request_item_workflow_stages', {req_item_id: sysId});
		fields.push(f);
	}
	
	function showTicketWidget(config, tableName, sysId) {
		var widgetParam = config.info_widget_param;
			if (widgetParam)
				widgetParam = JSON.parse(widgetParam);
			else
				widgetParam = {};
		
			widgetParam.table = tableName;
			widgetParam.sys_id = sysId;
			
			data.info_widget = $sp.getWidget(config.info_widget, widgetParam);
	}
	
	function showActionWidget(config, tableName, sysId) {
		var widgetParam = config.action_widget_param;
		if (widgetParam)
			widgetParam = JSON.parse(widgetParam);
		else
			widgetParam = {};

		widgetParam.table = tableName;
		widgetParam.sys_id = sysId;

		data.actionWidget = $sp.getWidget(config.action_widget, widgetParam);
	}
	
	function showDescription(config, record) {
		if (config.show_description == 'always')
			data.description = $sp.getField(record, 'description').display_value;
		else if (config.show_description == 'no_variable') {
			var variables = record.variables.getElements(true);
			if (variables.length == 0)
				data.description = $sp.getField(record, 'description').display_value;
		}
	}
	
	function buildInitials(name) {
		if (!name)
			return "--";

		var initialMatchRegex = /^[A-ZÀ-Ÿ]|^[\u3040-\u309f]|^[\u30a0-\u30ff]|^[\uff66-\uff9f]|^[\u4e00-\u9faf]/;
		// Included Hiragana, Katakana, CJK Unified Ideographs and Halfwidth and Fullwidth Forms Blocks 
		// Hiragana -> Japanese words, Katakana -> foreign words
		// CJK Unified Ideographs -> modern Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese characters 
		
		var initials = name.split(" ").map(function(word) {
			return word.toUpperCase();
		}).filter(function(word) {
			return word.match(initialMatchRegex);
		}).map(function(word) {
			return word.substring(0,1);
		}).join("");
		return (initials.length > 3) ? initials.substr(0, 3) : initials;
	}	
})()
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2023-05-17 17:36:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>bd4a33ee77fa21105c24f664be5a9924</sys_id><sys_mod_count>43</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Order details header</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Order Management" source="sn_ind_tmt_orm">3c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c711</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Order Management">3c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c711</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_bd4a33ee77fa21105c24f664be5a9924</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-18 06:20:41</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div ng-if="data.canRead && !data.hideHeader">
  
  <div class="panel-body no-padder">

    <div ng-if="!data.isEmpty" class= "form-group pull-left m-n">
      <span class="label-color m-n text-xs">{{::data.number.label}}</span>
      <div class="form-control no-padder no-border no-bg" id="data.number.name">{{::data.number.display_value}}</div>
    </div>
     <!-- New Order label and ID-->
    <div class="form-group pull-left m-n padder-md-r" style="margin-left: 20px;">
      <span class="label-color m-n text-xs">{{::data.number.label}}</span>
      <div class="form-control no-padder no-border no-bg">{{::data.number.display_value}}</div>
    </div>
    <div ng-if="data.headerFields.length > 0" class="pull-right">
      <div class= "form-group inline m-n" 
           ng-if="field.value && (field.type != 'decimal' || field.type == 'decimal' && field.value != 0)" 
           ng-repeat="field in data.headerFields"
           ng-class="{'padder-md-r': !$last}">
        <span class="label-color m-n text-xs">{{::field.label}}</span>
        <div ng-switch="field.type">
          <div ng-switch-when="glide_date_time" title="{{::field.display_value}}" class="form-control no-padder no-border no-bg">
            <sn-time-ago timestamp="::field.value"></sn-time-ago>
          </div>
          <div ng-switch-default class="form-control no-padder no-border no-bg">{{::field.display_value}}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel b">

    <div ng-if="!data.show_info_widget && data.fields.length > 0">
      <div class="panel-body">
        <div class="ticket-fields text-whitespace" ng-class="{'show-less': c.showMore}" ng-if="data.fields.length > 0" id="std-tkt-fields">
          <div class= "col-md-3 col-sm-3 col-xs-12 break-word adjust-height"
               ng-if="(field.type != 'decimal' || field.type == 'decimal' && field.value != 0)" 
               ng-repeat="field in data.fields| filter: {type:'!workflow'}">
            <div ng-switch="field.type">
              <div ng-switch-when="glide_date_time" title="{{field.display_value}}">
                <p class="label-color size text-xs header-text">{{::field.label}}</p>
                <span class="padding-sm" ng-if="field.name == 'due_date' || field.name == 'estimated_delivery'" data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{field.display_value}}">{{::field.display_value}}</span>
                <span ng-if="field.name != 'due_date' && field.name != 'estimated_delivery'" class="padding-sm">{{::field.display_value}}</span>
              </div>
              <div ng-switch-when="glide_list">
                <p class="label-color size header-text text-xs">{{::field.label}}</p>
                <span ng-if="field.reference == 'customer_contact' && field.value" ng-repeat="user in field.user" data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{::user.name}}">
                  <sn-avatar ng-click="openProfile(user.userID)" primary="user" enable-tooltip="false" enable-context-menu="true" show-presence="true" ng-style="{'cursor':'pointer'}"></sn-avatar>
                </span>
                <span ng-if="field.reference != 'sys_user' && field.value">
                  <span  ng-repeat="item in field.display_value"  class="header-text">
	                  <span data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{::item}}">{{::item}}</span>
  	                <span ng-if="!$last">,</span>
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div ng-switch-default ng-if="field.type != 'glide_list'">
                <span ng-if="field.reference == 'customer_contact' && field.value" class="pull-left avatar" data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{::field.user.name}}">
                  <sn-avatar ng-click="openProfile(field.user.userID)" primary=field.user enable-tooltip="false" enable-context-menu="true" show-presence="true" ng-style="{'cursor':'pointer'}"></sn-avatar>
                </span>
                <p class="label-color size header-text text-xs">{{::field.label}}</p>

                <span ng-if="field.reference != 'customer_contact' && field.reference != 'sys_user' && field.value" class="header-text"><span data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{::field.display_value}}">{{::field.display_value}}</span></span>
                <a ng-if="field.reference == 'customer_contact' && field.value" href="javascript:void(0);" aria-label="{{::field.label}} {{::field.display_value}}" ng-click="openProfile(field.user.userID)"  class="header-text align-tooltip" ng-style="{'cursor':'pointer'}">
                  <span data-toggle="tooltip" title="{{::field.display_value}}">{{::field.display_value}}</span>
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="options-btn btn show-more-controls visible-xs adjust-height" ng-click="c.showMore = !c.showMore" aria-expanded="{{!c.showMore}}" aria-controls="std-tkt-fields" ng-if="c.showControls">
        <span>{{c.showMore? '${Show more}' : '${Show less}' }}</span>
        <span style="font-size: 10px; padding-left:5px; padding-right:5px" class="glyphicon" ng-class="!c.showMore ? 'glyphicon-chevron-up' : 'glyphicon-chevron-down'"></span>
      </button>
      <div ng-repeat="field in data.fields|filter: {type:'workflow'}">
        <div class="panel-body padder-t-none">
          <p class="label-color size header-text text-xs">{{::field.label}}</p>
          <div class="padding-sm">
          <sp-widget widget="field.stageWidget"></sp-widget></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div ng-if="data.show_info_widget">
      <hr>
      <div class="panel-body">
        <sp-widget widget= "c.data.info_widget" page="{table:data.table, sys_id: data.sys_id}"></sp-widget>
      </div>
    </div>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>debugTriggerSubflow</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({ api, event, helpers }) {
    // 1. SPY ON THE RAW EVENT FIRST
    console.log("=== RAW EVENT PAYLOAD ===", event.payload);

    var actionName = (event.payload && event.payload.action && event.payload.action.name) ||
                     (event.payload && event.payload.name) ||
                     'UNKNOWN';
                     
    console.log("=== EXTRACTED ACTION NAME ===", actionName);
                     
    // 2. The Interceptor
    if (actionName !== 'trigger_sap_api') {
        console.warn("=== INTERCEPTOR TRIPPED: Ignoring click for action:", actionName);
        return;
    }
   
    // 3. Execute the actual integration
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId || api.context.page.sysId || api.state.sysId;
    console.log("=== STEP 1: GOT SYS_ID ===", sysId);

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id!");
        return;
    }

    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/trigger_sap_subflow/execute";
    console.log("=== STEP 2: EXECUTING VIA HELPERS.SNHTTP ===", endpoint);

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quoteSysId: sysId }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        console.log("=== STEP 3: SUBFLOW DISPATCH SUCCESS ===", response);
        var result = response.response.result || (response.data && response.data.result);
       
        if (result && result.success === false) {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                items: [{
                    id: 'sap_error_' + Date.now(),
                    status: 'critical',
                    icon: 'info-circle-outline',
                    content: result.error,
                    action: { type: 'dismiss' }
                }]
            });
        } else {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                items: [{
                    id: 'sap_success_' + Date.now(),
                    status: 'positive',
                    icon: 'check-circle-outline',
                    content: 'SAP synchronisiert',
                    action: { type: 'dismiss' }
                }]
            });
        }
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{
                id: 'sap_http_error',
                status: 'critical',
                content: 'Server error.',
                action: { type: 'dismiss' }
            }]
        });
    });
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>033b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d71</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>debugTriggerSubflow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_033b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d71</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf4690000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_033b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d71</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>3c5731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084d8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>Show submit for approval</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var result = false;

    if (!api.data.record || !api.data.record.form || !api.data.record.form.fields) {
        result = true;
    } else {
        var fields = api.data.record.form.fields;
        if (fields.state && fields.state.dictionary && fields.state.value !== undefined) {
            var canWrite = fields.state.dictionary.canWrite;
            var state = fields.state.value;
            var finalStates = ["completed", "closed", "canceled", "approved"];
            var hideSubmitButtonStates = ["requested_for_review"];

            if (!canWrite || finalStates.indexOf(state) > -1 || hideSubmitButtonStates.indexOf(state) > -1) {
                result = true;
            }
        } else {
            result = true;
        }
    }

    api.setState("hideSFA", result);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>0f3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d79</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Show submit for approval</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0f3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d79</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd04130000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0f3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d79</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>3557b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084d5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="DELETE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">21e8e11d909a0f501f183742f58c9acb</macroponent><name>show eol notification</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var output = event.payload.data.output;
    if (output['result'] && output.result.length > 0) {
        var items = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < output.result.length; i++) {
            var item = {
                id: 'alert' + i,
                status: 'critical',
                icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                content: output.result[i],
                action: {
                    type: 'dismiss'
                }
            };
            items.push(item);
        }
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: items
        });
    } else if (output['launchAdvancedApproval']) {
        helpers.modal.close('sfa_modal');
        var entityDetails = api.data.quote_management.entityDetails;

        var approvalEntityDetails = {
            "headerId": entityDetails.headerId,
            "metadata": {
                "sourceEntityId": entityDetails.metadata.sourceEntityId
            }
        };

        api.setState('approvalEntityDetails', approvalEntityDetails);
        api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
            viewportElementId: 'viewport_2',
            route: 'advance-approval'
        });
        helpers.modal.open('preview_approval_modal');
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-24 14:24:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>4ee8219190da0f501f183742f58c9aaa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>show eol notification</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4ee8219190da0f501f183742f58c9aaa</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-24 14:24:19</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>Route to New Contract</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    var quoteId = api.context.props.sysId;

    // 1. Grab the exact routing payload the native "New" button originally intended to send
    var navPayload = event.payload;

    // 2. Ensure the params object exists so we don't get undefined errors
    if (!navPayload.params) {
        navPayload.params = {};
    }

    // 3. Inject our parent Quote ID directly into the routing query
    navPayload.params.query = 'quote=' + quoteId;

    // 4. Broadcast it to the workspace's native tab router
    api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', navPayload);
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>0b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d82</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Route to New Contract</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d82</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd06270000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d82</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>f157f1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08418</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default">c862502443b9b1105bc56b23cbb8f27b</macroponent><name>debugTriggerQuoteLineSubflow</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({ api, helpers }) {
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId || api.context.page.sysId || api.state.sysId;
    console.log("=== STEP 1: GOT SYS_ID ===", sysId);

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id! ===");
        return;
    }

    var selectedRows = api.state.currentSelection;
    console.log("=== STEP 1b: GOT SELECTED ROWS ===", selectedRows);

    var selectedRecordIds = Object.keys(selectedRows || {});

    if (selectedRecordIds.length === 0) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: No rows selected! ===");
        return;
    }

    console.log("=== STEP 1c: EXTRACTED IDS ===", selectedRecordIds);

    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/executequoteline/execute";
    console.log("=== STEP 2: EXECUTING VIA HELPERS.SNHTTP ===", endpoint);

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quoteSysId: sysId, selectedRecordIds: selectedRecordIds }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        console.log("=== STEP 3: SUBFLOW DISPATCH SUCCESS ===", response);
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
    });
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-04 12:42:16</sys_created_on><sys_id>3bcc61f4106ec7104699cdb60f0cc94a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>debugTriggerQuoteLineSubflow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3bcc61f4106ec7104699cdb60f0cc94a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-04 12:51:16</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf20f0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3bcc61f4106ec7104699cdb60f0cc94a</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>e45731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08472</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:26</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
  if(api.state.enableHierarchicalList) {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  false);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  true);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "");
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  "");      
    } else {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  true);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  false);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "parent_line_item");
        var query = (api.state.nestByColumn ? api.state.nestByColumn  : "parent_line_item") + "ISEMPTY";
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  query);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>b04bbfa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c3ef</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Toggle Hierarchial List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b04bbfa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c3ef</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:19</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd09060000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b04bbfa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c3ef</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>4257f1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08474</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:32</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

                                                    "payload": {
                                                        "script": {
                                                            "apiVersion": "1.0.0",
                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n    api,\n    event\n}) {\n    return {\n        propName: \"selectedTabIndex\",\n        value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n    };\n\n    function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n        if (showRequestTracker()) {\n            var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n            for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n                if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n            }\n        }\n        return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n    }\n\n    function showRequestTracker() {\n        var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n        if (extraParams != null) {\n            var params = extraParams.split(',');\n            return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n                'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n}",
                                                            "scriptSysId": null,

                                                "apiVersion": "2.0.0",
                                                "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers\n */\nfunction evaluateProperty({\n    api,\n    helpers\n}) {\n    const productRecommendationDetails = api.data.quote_management.productRecommendationDetails;\n    if (!productRecommendationDetails) return true;\n    \n    const hasWriterRole = api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"admin\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"maint\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"sn_quote_mgmt_core.quote_writer\") != -1;\n    const isSalesAgreementEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteForSalesAgreement;\n    const isQuoteInTerminalState = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteInTerminatedState;\n    const isPluginEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isProductRecommendationPluginEnabled;\n\n    return !(hasWriterRole && !isSalesAgreementEnabled && !isQuoteInTerminalState && isPluginEnabled);\n}",

* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
  if(api.state.enableHierarchicalList) {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  false);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  true);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "");
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  "");      
    } else {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  true);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  false);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "parent_line_item");
        var query = (api.state.nestByColumn ? api.state.nestByColumn  : "parent_line_item") + "ISEMPTY";
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  query);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-24 14:24:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>64f8add188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f0831</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Toggle Hierarchial List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_64f8add188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f0831</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-24 14:24:29</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd05210000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_64f8add188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f0831</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>3d57b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084f4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    if(event.name == "DATA_OP_SUCCEEDED")
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {helpers.modal.close();}, 500);
    else if(event.name == "NOW_BUTTON#CLICKED")
        helpers.modal.close();
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>8b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>closeModal</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd05170000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8b3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8f</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>f557b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084f3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="DELETE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">21e8e11d909a0f501f183742f58c9acb</macroponent><name>Open sfa dialog</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again. If the problem persists, contact your system administrator."
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    try {
        var output = api.data.getexpiredproductoffering_1.output;
        
        if (output.productOfferingIds && output.productOfferingIds.length > 0) {
            helpers.modal.open('sfa_modal');
            return;
        }
        
        if (output.productOfferingIds && output.productOfferingIds.length === 0) {
            
            if (output.data.validationAPIResult && output.data.validationAPIResult.length > 0) {
                var items = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < output.data.validationAPIResult.length; i++) {
                    var item = {
                        id: 'alert' + i,
                        status: 'critical',
                        icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                        content: output.data.validationAPIResult[i],
                        action: {
                            type: 'dismiss'
                        }
                    };
                    items.push(item);
                }
                api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                    items: items
                });
                return;
            }
            else if (output.data.hasError && output.data.notificationMessage) {
                var notificationItem = {
                    id: 'alert',
                    status: 'positive',
                    icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                    content: output.data.notificationMessage,
                    action: {
                        type: 'dismiss'
                    }
                };
                api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                    items: [notificationItem]
                });
                return; 
            }
            else if (output.data.launchAdvancedApproval) {
                var entityDetails = api.data.quote_management.entityDetails;
                
            var approvalEntityDetails = {
                headerId: entityDetails.headerId,
                table_name: "sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote",
                versionIds: entityDetails.versionIds
            };

                api.setState('approvalEntityDetails', approvalEntityDetails);

                if (output.data.approvalData) {
                    api.setState('approvalPreviewData', output.data.approvalData);
                }

                api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
                    viewportElementId: 'viewport_2',
                    route: 'advance-approval'
                });

                helpers.modal.open('preview_approval_modal');
            }
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        var errorNotification = {
            id: 'unexpected-error',
            status: 'critical',
            icon: 'circle-close-outline',
            content: helpers.translate('An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again. If the problem persists, contact your system administrator.'),
            action: {
                type: 'dismiss'
            }
        };
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [errorNotification]
        });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-24 14:24:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>f1e8219190da0f501f183742f58c9a43</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Open sfa dialog</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f1e8219190da0f501f183742f58c9a43</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-24 14:24:18</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
