sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt.QuoteDecisionAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Accept / Reject Quote in CSM Portal</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QuoteDecisionAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QuoteDecisionAjax = Class.create();
QuoteDecisionAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    isPublic: function() {
        return true;
    },

    processDecision: function() {
        var decision = this.getParameter('sysparm_decision');
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax START ===');
        gs.info('Decision: ' + decision + ', Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        if (decision === 'accept') {
            gr.state = 'completed';
            gr.update();
            return 'Angebot erfolgreich akzeptiert';
        } else if (decision === 'reject') {
            return 'Bitte verwenden Sie das Formular "Ablehnen mit Grund"';
        } else {
            return 'Ungültige Entscheidung';
        }
    },

    rejectWithReason: function() {
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var reason = this.getParameter('sysparm_reason');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax rejectWithReason START ===');
        gs.info('Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table + ', Reason: ' + reason);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        // Prüfen ob Grund-Attribut existiert
        if (gr.isValidField('u_reason_for_rejection')) {
            gr.u_reason_for_rejection = reason;
        } else {
            gs.error('Das Feld u_reason_for_rejection existiert nicht!');
            return 'Ablehnungsfeld (u_reason_for_rejection) nicht gefunden';
        }

        gr.state = 'rejected';
        gr.update();

        gs.info('Angebot erfolgreich mit Grund abgelehnt');

        return 'Angebot erfolgreich abgelehnt.\nGrund: ' + reason;
    },

    returnForRevision: function() {
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var reason = this.getParameter('sysparm_reason');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax returnForRevision START ===');
        gs.info('Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table + ', Reason: ' + reason);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        // Prüfen ob Grund-Attribut existiert (für die Überarbeitung)
        if (gr.isValidField('u_reason_for_rejection')) {
            gr.u_reason_for_rejection = reason;
        } else {
            gs.error('Das Feld u_reason_for_rejection existiert nicht!');
            return 'Überarbeitungsfeld (u_reason_for_rejection) nicht gefunden';
        }

        gr.state = 'in_review';
        gr.update();

        gs.info('Angebot erfolgreich zur Überarbeitung zurückgegeben');

        return 'Angebot erfolgreich zur Überarbeitung zurückgegeben.\nGrund: ' + reason;
    },

    type: 'QuoteDecisionAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-09 15:21:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700</sys_id><sys_mod_count>29</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QuoteDecisionAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-11 11:31:07</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcef9b0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>5c5731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc0840a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="DELETE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">21e8e11d909a0f501f183742f58c9acb</macroponent><name>Show submit for approval</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var result = false;

    if (!api.data.record || !api.data.record.form || !api.data.record.form.fields) {
        result = true;
    } else {
        var fields = api.data.record.form.fields;
        if (fields.state && fields.state.dictionary && fields.state.value !== undefined) {
            var canWrite = fields.state.dictionary.canWrite;
            var state = fields.state.value;
            var finalStates = ["completed", "closed", "canceled", "approved"];
            var hideSubmitButtonStates = ["requested_for_review"];

            if (!canWrite || finalStates.indexOf(state) > -1 || hideSubmitButtonStates.indexOf(state) > -1) {
                result = true;
            }
        } else {
            result = true;
        }
    }

    api.setState("hideSFA", result);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>Clear All Contracts</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId;

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id! ===");
        return;
    }

    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/lbbw_revenue_contracts/delete_all";

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quote_id: sysId }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
       
        // 1. Show the success notification
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{type: 'info', message: 'Alle Verträge wurden erfolgreich gelöscht.', action: {type: 'dismiss'}}]
        });
       
        // 2. Wait 1 second, then force the workspace router to reload the current tab
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
            api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', {
                route: 'record',
                fields: {
                    table: api.context.props.table,
                    sysId: api.context.props.sysId
                }
            });
        }, 1000);
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
    });
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>073b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Clear All Contracts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_073b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcfc390000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_073b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d8b</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>dd5771a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084d9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:29</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default">c862502443b9b1105bc56b23cbb8f27b</macroponent><name>Route to New Contract</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    var quoteId = api.context.props.sysId;

    // 1. Grab the exact routing payload the native "New" button originally intended to send
    var navPayload = event.payload;

    // 2. Ensure the params object exists so we don't get undefined errors
    if (!navPayload.params) {
        navPayload.params = {};
    }

    // 3. Inject our parent Quote ID directly into the routing query
    navPayload.params.query = 'quote=' + quoteId;

    // 4. Broadcast it to the workspace's native tab router
    api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', navPayload);
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-16 11:53:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>630ce218f47a8f501f18b238e2e23845</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Route to New Contract</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_630ce218f47a8f501f18b238e2e23845</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-16 11:59:21</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd001e0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_630ce218f47a8f501f18b238e2e23845</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>6d57b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc0844a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Default">304bffa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c33d</macroponent><name>Toggle Hierarchial List</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
  if(api.state.enableHierarchicalList) {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  false);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  true);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "");
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  "");      
    } else {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  true);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  false);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "parent_line_item");
        var query = (api.state.nestByColumn ? api.state.nestByColumn  : "parent_line_item") + "ISEMPTY";
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  query);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>f04bffa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c354</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Toggle Hierarchial List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f04bffa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c354</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:20</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd02ad0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f04bffa58107c7dcb0e42d062435c354</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>e157b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc0849c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>Open sfa dialog</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again. If the problem persists, contact your system administrator."
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    try {
        var output = api.data.getexpiredproductoffering_1.output;
        
        if (output.productOfferingIds && output.productOfferingIds.length > 0) {
            helpers.modal.open('sfa_modal');
            return;
        }
        
        if (output.productOfferingIds && output.productOfferingIds.length === 0) {
            
            if (output.data.validationAPIResult && output.data.validationAPIResult.length > 0) {
                var items = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < output.data.validationAPIResult.length; i++) {
                    var item = {
                        id: 'alert' + i,
                        status: 'critical',
                        icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                        content: output.data.validationAPIResult[i],
                        action: {
                            type: 'dismiss'
                        }
                    };
                    items.push(item);
                }
                api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                    items: items
                });
                return;
            }
            else if (output.data.hasError && output.data.notificationMessage) {
                var notificationItem = {
                    id: 'alert',
                    status: 'positive',
                    icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                    content: output.data.notificationMessage,
                    action: {
                        type: 'dismiss'
                    }
                };
                api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                    items: [notificationItem]
                });
                return; 
            }
            else if (output.data.launchAdvancedApproval) {
                var entityDetails = api.data.quote_management.entityDetails;
                
            var approvalEntityDetails = {
                headerId: entityDetails.headerId,
                table_name: "sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote",
                versionIds: entityDetails.versionIds
            };

                api.setState('approvalEntityDetails', approvalEntityDetails);

                if (output.data.approvalData) {
                    api.setState('approvalPreviewData', output.data.approvalData);
                }

                api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
                    viewportElementId: 'viewport_2',
                    route: 'advance-approval'
                });

                helpers.modal.open('preview_approval_modal');
            }
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        var errorNotification = {
            id: 'unexpected-error',
            status: 'critical',
            icon: 'circle-close-outline',
            content: helpers.translate('An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again. If the problem persists, contact your system administrator.'),
            action: {
                type: 'dismiss'
            }
        };
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [errorNotification]
        });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>3a3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d5f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Open sfa dialog</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3a3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d5f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf5cf0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3a3b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d5f</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>f85771a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08406</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="DELETE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default">c862502443b9b1105bc56b23cbb8f27b</macroponent><name>submit_for_approval/label</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Preview & Submit for approval"
    },
    {
        "message": "Submit for approval"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.data.quote_management.entityDetails.isAdvanceApprovalsEnabled)
        return helpers.translateSync('Preview & Submit for Approval');
    else {
        return helpers.translateSync('Submit for Approval');

    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-03 20:16:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>bc8f0ad6fff6f610588affffffffff87</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>submit_for_approval/label</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_bc8f0ad6fff6f610588affffffffff87</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-03 20:16:39</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

                                                        "script": {
                                                            "apiVersion": "1.0.0",
                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n    api,\n    event\n}) {\n    return {\n        propName: \"selectedTabIndex\",\n        value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n    };\n\n    function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n        if (showRequestTracker()) {\n            var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n            for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n                if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n            }\n        }\n        return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n    }\n\n    function showRequestTracker() {\n        var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n        if (extraParams != null) {\n            var params = extraParams.split(',');\n            return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n                'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n}",

                                                "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers\n */\nfunction evaluateProperty({\n    api,\n    helpers\n}) {\n    const productRecommendationDetails = api.data.quote_management.productRecommendationDetails;\n    if (!productRecommendationDetails) return true;\n    \n    const hasWriterRole = api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"admin\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"maint\") != -1 || api.context.session.user.roles.indexOf(\"sn_quote_mgmt_core.quote_writer\") != -1;\n    const isSalesAgreementEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteForSalesAgreement;\n    const isQuoteInTerminalState = productRecommendationDetails.isQuoteInTerminatedState;\n    const isPluginEnabled = productRecommendationDetails.isProductRecommendationPluginEnabled;\n\n    return !(hasWriterRole && !isSalesAgreementEnabled && !isQuoteInTerminalState && isPluginEnabled);\n}",

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Delete All Contracts</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    var requestBody = request.body.data;
    var quoteId = requestBody.quote_id;

    // 1. Capture exactly what UI Builder is sending
    var uiBuilderPayload = JSON.stringify(requestBody);

    // 2. Query the records
    var contractGr = new GlideRecord('x_fitsg_fits_som_1_lbbw_revenue_contracts');
    contractGr.addQuery('quote', quoteId);
    contractGr.query();
   
    var recordsFound = contractGr.getRowCount();
    var count = 0;
    var deleteResults = [];

    // 3. Attempt deletion and log the success/failure of each row
    while (contractGr.next()) {
        var success = contractGr.deleteRecord();
        deleteResults.push(success); // Will log 'true' if deleted, 'false' if blocked
        if (success) {
            count++;
        }
    }

    // 4. Return the full diagnostic report to your browser
    response.setStatus(200);
    return {
        "status": "Diagnostic complete",
        "received_payload": uiBuilderPayload,
        "records_found": recordsFound,
        "deletion_results": deleteResults,
        "message": count + " records actually deleted"
    };
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/sn_quote_mgmt/lbbw_revenue_contracts/delete_all</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/delete_all</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-15 sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_eb7fd37590d68f501f183742f58c9af2
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Execute</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTRequest*/ request, /*RESTResponse*/ response) {
    var body = request.body.data;
    var quoteSysId = body.quoteSysId;

    try {
        var quoteGr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
        if (quoteGr.get(quoteSysId)) {
           
            var contractNumber = quoteGr.getDisplayValue('u_revenue_contract_link');
            if (!contractNumber) {
                return { success: false, error: "Erlösvertragsnummer ist leer" };
            }
           
            var subflowInputs = {};
            // THE FIX IS HERE: We pass the GlideRecord object, not the sys_id string
            subflowInputs['quote'] = quoteGr;
            subflowInputs['contract_number'] = contractNumber;

            // 1. Run in FOREGROUND so the UI waits for the answer
            var result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
                .subflow('x_fitsg_fits_som_1.retrieve_sap_order_data')
                .inForeground()
                .withInputs(subflowInputs)
                .run();
               
            // 2. Grab the outputs from the finished subflow
            var outputs = result.getOutputs();
           
            // 3. Check if the subflow passed back our custom error message
            if (outputs.error_message && outputs.error_message != "") {
                return { success: false, error: outputs.error_message };
            }
               
            return { success: true };
        }
        return { success: false, error: "Record not found" };
    } catch (ex) {
        var errMsg = ex.message;
        // If the flow crashed because SAP timed out
        if (errMsg.indexOf('ended in state: ERROR') > -1) {
            return { success: false, error: "SAP kann nicht erreicht werden" };
        }
        // For any other random ServiceNow errors
        return { success: false, error: "Ein Fehler ist aufgetreten: " + errMsg };
    }
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/sn_quote_mgmt/trigger_sap_subflow/execute</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/execute</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>false</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-26 sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Populate OE from Product Offering</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Check if Product Offering is linked to the Quote Line Item
    if (!gs.nil(current.product_offering)) {
       
        var productGr = new GlideRecord('sn_prd_pm_product_offering');
        if (productGr.get(current.product_offering)) {
           
            // Get sys_id from Delivery ORG Unit field (u_som_delivery_org_unit)
            var deliveryOrgSysId = productGr.getValue('u_som_delivery_org_unit');
           
            // If Delivery ORG Unit exists on the product, populate OE; otherwise leave empty
            if (!gs.nil(deliveryOrgSysId)) {
                current.u_som_oe_leistung = deliveryOrgSysId;
            } else {
                current.u_som_oe_leistung = '';
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Clear OE if no product offering is linked
        current.u_som_oe_leistung = '';
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD62</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-13 14:52:54</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3316b61f68374710b0e4e691f7bdbe44</sys_id><sys_mod_count>11</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Populate OE from Product Offering</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_3316b61f68374710b0e4e691f7bdbe44</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD62</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-14 14:09:27</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=3316b61f68374710b0e4e691f7bdbe44"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcef7b0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_3316b61f68374710b0e4e691f7bdbe44</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>9c5731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08406</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:25</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

* @param {api} params.api

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>show eol notification</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var output = event.payload.data.output;
    if (output['result'] && output.result.length > 0) {
        var items = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < output.result.length; i++) {
            var item = {
                id: 'alert' + i,
                status: 'critical',
                icon: 'circle-close-outline',
                content: output.result[i],
                action: {
                    type: 'dismiss'
                }
            };
            items.push(item);
        }
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: items
        });
    } else if (output['launchAdvancedApproval']) {
        helpers.modal.close('sfa_modal');
        var entityDetails = api.data.quote_management.entityDetails;

        var approvalEntityDetails = {
            "headerId": entityDetails.headerId,
            "metadata": {
                "sourceEntityId": entityDetails.metadata.sourceEntityId
            }
        };

        api.setState('approvalEntityDetails', approvalEntityDetails);
        api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
            viewportElementId: 'viewport_2',
            route: 'advance-approval'
        });
        helpers.modal.open('preview_approval_modal');
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>833b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023dc4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>show eol notification</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_833b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023dc4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:13</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf5840000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_833b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023dc4</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>385731a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc084fd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default copy">ae3b3765c9834790b96b412c13023d4c</macroponent><name>debugTriggerQuoteLineSubflow</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({ api, helpers }) {
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId || api.context.page.sysId || api.state.sysId;
    console.log("=== STEP 1: GOT SYS_ID ===", sysId);

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id! ===");
        return;
    }

    var selectedRows = api.state.currentSelection;
    console.log("=== STEP 1b: GOT SELECTED ROWS ===", selectedRows);

    var selectedRecordIds = Object.keys(selectedRows || {});

    if (selectedRecordIds.length === 0) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: No rows selected! ===");
        return;
    }

    console.log("=== STEP 1c: EXTRACTED IDS ===", selectedRecordIds);

    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/executequoteline/execute";
    console.log("=== STEP 2: EXECUTING VIA HELPERS.SNHTTP ===", endpoint);

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quoteSysId: sysId, selectedRecordIds: selectedRecordIds }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        console.log("=== STEP 3: SUBFLOW DISPATCH SUCCESS ===", response);
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
    });
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>363b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d68</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>debugTriggerQuoteLineSubflow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_363b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d68</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 02:29:12</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd05d90000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_363b3ba5c9834790b96b412c13023d68</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>f957f1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc0840d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:31</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Quote Management Default">c862502443b9b1105bc56b23cbb8f27b</macroponent><name>Clear All Contracts</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId;

    if (!sysId) {
        console.error("=== ERROR: Missing Quote sys_id! ===");
        return;
    }

    var endpoint = "/api/sn_quote_mgmt/lbbw_revenue_contracts/delete_all";

    helpers.snHttp(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { quote_id: sysId }
    })
    .then(function(response) {
       
        // 1. Show the success notification
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{type: 'info', message: 'Alle Verträge wurden erfolgreich gelöscht.', action: {type: 'dismiss'}}]
        });
       
        // 2. Wait 1 second, then force the workspace router to reload the current tab
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
            api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', {
                route: 'record',
                fields: {
                    table: api.context.props.table,
                    sysId: api.context.props.sysId
                }
            });
        }, 1000);
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
        console.error("=== STEP 3: HTTP ERROR ===", error);
    });
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-14 15:26:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>74d3a033f4a6cb501f18b238e2e238ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Clear All Contracts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_74d3a033f4a6cb501f18b238e2e238ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-15 14:01:43</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bd00ff0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_74d3a033f4a6cb501f18b238e2e238ea</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>e957b1a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08467</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:30</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
  if(api.state.enableHierarchicalList) {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  false);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  true);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "");
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  "");      
    } else {
        api.setState("enableHierarchicalList",  true);
        api.setState("enableFilters",  false);
        api.setState("nestByColumn",  "parent_line_item");
        var query = (api.state.nestByColumn ? api.state.nestByColumn  : "parent_line_item") + "ISEMPTY";
        api.setState("fixedFilter",  query);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-24 14:24:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>54f86dd188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f08a2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Toggle Hierarchial List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_54f86dd188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f08a2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-24 14:24:27</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188bcf6e90000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_54f86dd188d60bd0b0e4bb68a04f08a2</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>10.5.1</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Application</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>f05771a8f094db10b0e43cf86fc08426</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 17:37:27</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>
